evals.prompt: I need a statistical infographic on global AI market size and growth projections for our department's annual report. Pull accurate up-to-date numbers, don't make them up.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-infographics in statistical mode with research enabled (--type statistical --research --doc-type report): before drawing, gathers 5-8 current (2023-2026) market-size and growth figures with web search from named primary sources, records each with its source URL in a _research.json file, and shows disagreeing estimates as a range or with attribution instead of inventing or averaging numbers. Lays the infographic out as SVG with charts computed from those values and a source line, renders it locally (keyless; no API key requested), and reviews the render against the report document-type threshold (8.0/10) with iteration that stops once met. Output is a versioned PNG plus the research JSON and a review log.

assertions.value: Uses the --research flag to source real statistics rather than inventing numbers, and reviews quality against a document-type threshold before finishing.

evals.prompt: Make me a timeline infographic of our lab's milestones from 2010 to 2025 in a corporate style for the homepage.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-infographics in timeline mode (--type timeline --style corporate): lays out a chronological SVG infographic with date markers and event nodes for all nine milestones in lab_milestones.md (2010 founding through the 2025 15th anniversary, including the 2019 SeaTrace launch), using the lab name, tagline and brand colours given there, renders it locally without an API key, reviews the render and iterates only if below the document-type threshold, and outputs a versioned PNG with a review log.

assertions.value: Builds the timeline from the attached lab_milestones.md (Halcyon Marine Genomics Lab, 2010 founding through the 2025 15th anniversary) instead of asking for or inventing milestones.

evals.prompt: I want a side-by-side comparison infographic of electric vs hydrogen vehicles for a conference handout, and it has to be colorblind-safe.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-infographics in comparison mode with an accessible palette (--type comparison --palette wong): produces a side-by-side SVG comparison graphic of battery-electric vs hydrogen fuel-cell vehicles with matching rows, using Wong's colorblind-safe palette plus non-colour cues, any figures sourced (--research) rather than invented, rendered locally with a grayscale check and reviewed against the document-type threshold with iteration; no API key is needed.

assertions.value: Selects a colorblind-safe palette (e.g. wong) and produces a comparison-type layout.

evals.prompt: Can you build a process infographic showing the five steps of our podcast production workflow for a social media post?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-infographics in process/how-to mode (--type process, social-oriented style): asks for or uses the user's five steps, lays out a numbered step-by-step SVG graphic with directional flow at a social format (e.g. 1080x1080), renders it locally, and reviews it against the social document-type threshold (7.0/10) with early stopping when met; no API key is needed.

assertions.value: Selects the process (--type process) preset for a numbered step-by-step workflow rather than a generic image.

evals.prompt: My OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set. Use the Nano Banana image model to generate a list infographic of five tips for writing a data management plan, for our faculty newsletter.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-infographics on its optional AI backend because the user asked for the image model: runs scripts/generate_infographic.py with the five-tips description, --type list, a newsletter-appropriate --doc-type, -o to a PNG and --backend ai (Nano Banana Pro generation, Gemini 3.1 Pro review, iteration to the threshold, review log). Notes that the model draws the text itself, so the tips must be proofread on the image.

assertions.value: Uses the AI backend explicitly with the list type preset and warns that generated text must be proofread.

evals.prompt: I need a CONSORT participant flow diagram for my randomized controlled trial paper, showing 500 screened, 150 excluded, and 350 randomized into two arms.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-scientific-schematics. A CONSORT methodology flowchart for a peer-reviewed paper is a technical scientific diagram, which the skill's own 'Use scientific-schematics instead' guidance routes to alterlab-scientific-schematics rather than the infographic generator.

evals.prompt: Generate a photorealistic hero image of a researcher working at a holographic lab bench for our grant website banner.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-generate-image. This is general non-infographic visual content (a photorealistic illustration), not a data-story graphic with sourced figures or a designed information layout, so it belongs to alterlab-generate-image.

evals.prompt: Plot our lab's yearly publication counts from this CSV as an exact bar chart for the grant progress report — every bar must match the data.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-matplotlib. An exact chart of a dataset needs a plotting library that draws the real values from the file; an infographic is a designed layout around a few headline figures, not a data plot.
